nodes.name: callback_handlers.md
nodes.summary: Reference guide for all WhatsApp callback button handlers in the Ordelo system, covering 8 handler types including rider dispatch accept/decline, shift management, restaurant order confirmation, pickup time selection, and admin controls.

nodes.name: delivery_process.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive reference for the full 6-phase Ordelo delivery lifecycle — from order creation through restaurant confirmation, dispatch creation, rider assignment, inflight execution with LangGraph agent, and completion — covering database tables, status transitions, scheduled jobs, SQL file references, and webhook endpoints.

nodes.name: delivery_process_explorer.html
nodes.summary: Interactive HTML single-page application that visually explores the Ordelo delivery process, allowing users to navigate delivery phases, view status transitions, and understand the end-to-end flow through a browser-based interface.
nodes.languageNotes: Self-contained single-file HTML with embedded CSS and JavaScript; no external dependencies required for viewing.

nodes.name: dispatch_flow.md
nodes.summary: Detailed step-by-step guide to the Ordelo dispatch flow — from DB-triggered dispatch creation through WhatsApp rider notification, accept/decline callbacks, assignment job execution, inflight graph initialization, and the pre-pickup cancellation and re-dispatch paths.

nodes.name: get_restaurant_webhook_url_async_guide.md
nodes.summary: Developer guide for the `get_restaurant_webhook_url_async` utility function in `config/params.py`, covering its signature, valid webhook types, database configuration, usage examples, error handling, and migration notes from the synchronous predecessor.

nodes.name: location_overview.md
nodes.summary: Overview of the rider live-location event processing pipeline, covering end-to-end flow from OwnTracks MQTT events through DB queue processing, webhook handling in `location_hooks.py`, and the live-map and null-location endpoints.

nodes.name: payment_and_order_flow.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive guide to the Ordelo payment and order creation flow, covering pre-order validation (minimum order value, postcode), Stripe and pay-at-restaurant payment paths, address capture via WhatsApp Flow, and the webhook endpoints in `payment_hooks.py`, `order_hooks.py`, and `thread_hooks.py`.

nodes.name: pickup_time_logic.md
nodes.summary: Explains the pickup time selection logic for both delivery and takeaway orders, tracing the trigger chain from restaurant acceptance through admin selection, timeout auto-accept, mid-delivery adjustment, and external restaurant notification for takeaway.

nodes.name: takeaway_flow.md
nodes.summary: Full reference for the Ordelo takeaway order flow, covering initialization via Stripe and pay-at-restaurant paths, restaurant confirmation lifecycle, pickup time selection with external notification, decline and timeout handling, and complete status transition tables.
